failure_modes.mode: Packed-bed blockage / channelling due to catalyst fines migration
failure_modes.cause: Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 particles (particle size, voidage, and loading unspecified) can migrate under low-Re trickle flow (Re≈5), plug the downstream connector or BPR orifice, or create preferential channels that bypass catalyst — eliminating gas-liquid-solid contact and causing uncontrolled pressure excursion or loss of conversion
failure_modes.mitigation: Install a 10–20 µm sintered SS frit at both bed ends; record inlet pressure continuously and halt run if ΔP rises >2 bar above baseline; characterise particle size distribution before packing

failure_modes.mode: H2 gas-phase breakthrough to liquid collector (BPR failure / slug flow bypassing separator)
failure_modes.cause: At 21 bar and Q_gas_actual ≈ 0.08 mL/min the gas holdup is unmeasured; if the gas-liquid separator fails to disengage or the BPR chatters, pressurised H2 can reach the atmospheric-rated (1 bar) collection vessel, creating an explosive atmosphere in a grounded but open vessel
failure_modes.mitigation: Confirm gas-liquid separator (max 25 bar) is upstream of BPR and vented to a dedicated H2 safe-vent line; verify collection vessel is downstream of BPR at ≤1 bar; install H2 gas detector at separator vent; do not open collector during run

failure_modes.mode: Oxygen ingress causing pyrophoric catalyst ignition on shutdown or bed opening
failure_modes.cause: Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 (Pearlman's catalyst) is O2-sensitive; residual methanol solvent in the bed at 60 °C combined with air admission during column disassembly can cause rapid oxidation/ignition of finely divided Pd; the system has no inline O2 monitor and no degasser
failure_modes.mitigation: Purge with N2 (gas_n2_cylinder) at ≥5 bed volumes before any line opening; cool bed to <30 °C under N2 before disassembly; confirm O2 <100 ppm at vent with portable O2 sensor before breaking any fitting

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve (bpr_h2_21) — sole pressure-control device; blockage by catalyst fines stops all flow and causes uncontrolled pressure build-up; no redundant pressure-relief path is listed in inventory
MFC (mfc_h2_100) — sole H2 flow-control device; failure open delivers unmetered H2; failure closed starves reaction and may cause pump cavitation on methanol at 60 °C
Check valve (safety_h2_check_valve) — sole device preventing liquid methanol backflow into H2 gas line and MFC; failure allows solvent ingress and potential pump damage or ignition source
validation_experiments: Hydraulic commissioning (no catalyst, no H2): pump methanol at Q=0.5 mL/min through the packed bed loaded with inert glass beads of representative particle size at 60 °C and 21 bar BPR; record inlet pressure every 30 s for 60 min; accept if ΔP is stable within ±0.5 bar and no fines appear in effluent — establishes baseline ΔP, confirms frit integrity, and validates that empty-tube proxy ΔP≈0 bar is physically reasonable before introducing H2

Gas-liquid separator and BPR functional test: introduce H2 via MFC at 1.4 sccm into methanol flow at 0.5 mL/min at 21 bar with catalyst bed replaced by inert packing; verify separator cleanly disengages gas to safe vent and liquid exits BPR at ≤1 bar; confirm H2 detector alarm threshold with controlled H2 release — validates single-point-of-failure BPR and separator before reactive run

N2 inert-purge qualification: with catalyst bed installed and system at ambient temperature, flow N2 at maximum available regulator pressure through all lines for 10 min; measure O2 concentration at separator vent until O2 <100 ppm for three consecutive readings — establishes minimum purge protocol required before H2 introduction and before any bed disassembly, directly addressing the pyrophoric ignition failure mode
